title: VeloraOS 1.10.36 - Single Main Model + Coding Toggle
releaseNotes: Simplifies normal Chat to one main Qwen2.5 3B runtime instead of Automatic, Tiny, Quick and Deep Thoughts.
Adds a Coding switch that automatically selects the strongest sensible installed coding model for the detected hardware.
Keeps older general models only as migration fallbacks while always preferring Qwen2.5 3B once installed.
Makes Cosmic Reasoning independent from model choice and applies the selected 1-5 value to backend generation.
Replaces the mobile tap-to-cycle Cosmic Reasoning control with a real slider and proper Coding/Lockdown switches.
Preserves reliable response continuation, hidden-reasoning protection, Knowledge and automatic Web Intelligence.
